verdict.rationale: Kong is an API gateway providing routing, plugins, and AI/MCP traffic governance, but there is no evidence of a rules engine or event-trigger automation system that lets an AI-native user define 'if event X then action Y' rules; plugins are traffic-processing hooks configured by admins, not user-defined event-triggered automation. missing for 10: any evidence of event-driven trigger/rule definition (e.g., webhooks-on-event, conditional automation workflows, rule builder), and independent confirmation of such a feature.
